applicabilityBasis.summary: USDfr is a 1:1 USDC-minted transferable credit-backed dollar, but the issuer reserves token characterization and eligibility to definitive onboarding legal materials that are not public. Payment-stablecoin versus securities applicability remains unresolved.

genius.notes: Forest Road is the named protocol operator/originator, but the exact token-contracting legal entity is not established by the reviewed public legal page. No approval or absence-of-authorization finding is inferred from KYC or timelocked governance. MiCA is intentionally unassessed because fund/security characterization and EU offering scope are unverified.
